title: Better Brick Recipes
description: This data-pack is meant to be used in tandem with Better Bricks.
body:
This data-pack is meant to be used with Better Bricks, a resource pack I made aswell, This adds crafting recipes to some of the bricks in the resource pack to better fit the texture. This is fully optional but is certainly recommended. An outdated version may lead to confusion so i'd recommend checking the changelogs to inspect the compatible versions.

NOTE: The gallery image's output block(bricks/chiseled variants) may not look accurate if you have the resource pack. The recipe itself has no possibility of such things occuring.
